approve.reason: Southwest Minnesota State "Paying for College" page, panel "Estimated Total Cost — Undergraduate Cost for 2026-27", table captioned "Cost breakdown to attend SMSU": Tuition & Fees $11,516, Housing & Food $11,850, Books, Materials, Supplies, Equipment $1,200, Transportation, Personal Expenses, Loan fees $3,652, TOTAL $28,218, copied as printed. Undergraduate (the panel reads "Undergraduate Cost for 2026-27"), academic year ("The annual cost of attendance is shown in the Estimated Total Cost panel"), on campus (the page says "Housing and food include your residence hall room and your meal plan cost", based on "a double-occupancy room ... in the traditional residence hall"); student_population and living_arrangement are set from those printed lines (set_fields). Open issue residency_unknown accepted: residency is recorded as not_applicable because SMSU charges one rate to nearly every student. Its cost-of-attendance page (budget.html, retained as this decision's source_evidence) states "SMSU does Not charge out-of-state tuition (with very few exceptions)" and "SMSU offers in-state tuition to nearly everyone. No out-state tuition rates. Reciprocity rates may apply to students from ND, IA, MSEP States and Manitoba."; those exceptions are not covered by this record. That page's "Tuition and Fee costs" table prints the same Undergraduate column (Tuition & Fees $11,516, Housing and Food $11,850, Books $1,200, Transportation, Personal Expenses, Loan fees $3,652, Total $28,218). Open issue conflicting_sources accepted: the other source is that page's one-semester budget ("Tuition and Fees (at 12-18 credits)" $5,758, "Housing and Food Estimate" $5,925), the same budget per semester; it is rejected below so only the annual figures are recorded.
